## Overview

LRP77base is the **no-period-variation companion** to [LRP77](../lrp-rli-dose-077/). It is
the identical dose-response model — Beta-Binomial conditional change on word
reading ($W$, $N = 79$), the same on-intervention indicator, post-crossover arm
term, own baseline, linear age and subject random intercept — except the
within-child attendance deviation enters as a **single pooled slope**
$\beta_{\text{dose}}$ instead of the partial-pooled per-period slopes
$\beta_{\text{dose}[p]}$. It fits **no** cumulative-dose control, exactly as LRP77
does not.

Its sole purpose is the nested **leave-one-child-out PSIS** comparison against
LRP77 (`scripts/compare_statistical_models.py`): *does letting the attendance
slope vary by period improve prediction for a child the model has not seen?*
Given the weak Phase-1 dose structure, LRP77 is expected to shrink toward this
model and the comparison to be near-indistinguishable; it is read cautiously at
this $n$ because the dynamic companions were not estimable. See the LRP77 report
for the full estimand, the extensive/intensive split, the unblocked latent-ability
path, the $G = 2 - \text{group}$ coding (G=1 = intervention), and the expectations
caveat.
